name: Intersection of Noble St. & Westwall St.
desc1: This is a cobblestoned street. It is dimly lit by guttering lanterns
desc2: hung from tall posts. Noble street and Westwall street bend around the
desc3: side of the guard tower to the southwest here, meeting in the middle.
desc4: Noble street continues off to the east, with Westwall street going
desc5: to the north. The sides of clustered housing is to the north and east.
desc6: Off to the south, you can see the entrance to the slums.
